title: CockroachDB backup and recovery
brief: Restore a CockroachDB history and reconcile a later valid booking without consuming capacity twice.
outcomes: Validate full/incremental backup coverage and restore scope
Close source writes and reconcile booking identity, capacity and external effects
entry: General recovery and fenced reconciliation, the class booking invariant and CockroachDB transactions.

neighbours.RL96: Owns the closed-history reconciliation and acceptance contract.

heading.title: Backup coverage
heading.brief: Pin version, storage, privileges and licensed capabilities; form a full/incremental chain and state whether revision history and cluster metadata are included.

heading.title: A chosen history
heading.brief: Record the proposed accidental change and a later valid booking with unique identity; select a supported restore target and scope.

heading.title: Restore acceptance
heading.brief: Restore into an owned isolated destination, test a broken chain and verify rows, constraints, identities and relevant grants or settings.

heading.title: Reconciliation and handover
heading.brief: Fence the old write authority, settle in-flight and uncertain requests, then enumerate the closed set of valid excluded work. Reapply B203 and its capacity decrement once, reconcile external effects and repeat identity/capacity acceptance over that final set. Keep old writes fenced through handover; test a booking attempt at the fence boundary so it is accounted for or rejected.
